abstract: The rare-high-fidelity first-passage time of isotropic projective Brownian motion has an explicit dimension-sharp first correction to its mean-rescaled exponential Laplace law, together with a strict finite-threshold coefficient-of-variation deficit.
integrity: The proof supplies the analytic estimates; finite high-precision checks are corroborative, not infinite-parameter certificates.
scientific_limitations: Fixed n >= 2; no uniform high-dimension scaling is established.
Isotropic Brownian limit started from exactly orthogonal fidelity, not arbitrary initial-state or discrete-step trajectories.
Nonasymptotic upper bound requires alpha_n*theta < mean dimensionless hitting time.
Sharpness is an asymptotic first coefficient, not finite-threshold pointwise optimality.
Generic Jacobi Laplace formulas and rare-event exponential limit theory predate this result.
External independent verification has not been performed.
title: Dimension-sharp exponential preparation times for isotropic quantum-state diffusion
